verdict.rationale: Atlas documents a registered agent service for Delaware compliance, and a registered agent supplies its own address for state filings. For the company address, Atlas offers only a partner virtual address and explicitly suggests the founder's home address as an option. Nothing in the evidence states which provider address appears on public filings or that home addresses stay off the record. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the provider's address replaces the founder's on state filings, coverage of which filings and states permit it, a first-party (not partner) business address option, and independent corroboration of privacy outcomes.

support.subject: As a founder, I can use the provider's address on state filings where the provider permits it, keeping my home address off the public record

citations.quote: Satisfy Delaware compliance requirements with a registered agent.
If you don’t have an official company address yet, you can use your home address or get a virtual address through one of our partners.
